output.objective: Move Harbor Pilates class booking out of Instagram DMs into a paid, self-serve schedule with an automatic waitlist before the summer schedule ships.
scope: Public schedule and class detail pages with capacity
Booking and Stripe payment flow with confirmation email
Waitlist with first-in-line claim window texts
Instructor admin: schedule edit, roster, no-shows

milestones.name: Schedule and class pages live on staging
Booking and payment flow complete
milestones.deliverable: A test booking paid end to end

milestones.name: Waitlist automation running
milestones.deliverable: Claim-window text fires on a freed spot

milestones.name: Instructor admin and summary email
milestones.deliverable: Admin demo plus first morning summary

milestones.name: QA, launch checklist, go live
milestones.deliverable: Production launch on the studio domain

access_checklist: Domain registrar access or a delegated subdomain
Class schedule, pricing, and policies document
SMS provider account or approval to create one at cost
risks: Summer schedule deadline leaves one week of slack; decision turnaround above 48 hours consumes it
SMS sender registration can take days; start in week one
